name: ANSI/IEEE Minimum-current monitoring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of minimum-current monitoring relay: a minimum-current relay operates according to a configured low-current condition.
description: This reference locates minimum-current monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented current protection relays family. A minimum-current relay operates according to a configured low-current condition. Control drawings must identify whether it supervises an operating load, a permissive or another circuit. The public library uses HCR1F26 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Check how the relay handles zero current during intentional shutdown. Low current can be an intentional stopped state; the control logic defines when it is abnormal. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
